subject_definitions.identity: 黎黎隆本人；红色长发、既有脸型与好胜尖锐表情、红白黑机械装甲、青蓝功能信号、机械龙爪脚、模块化身体和一条具有上中下节奏的长机械龙尾。
subject_definitions.personality_expression: 好胜、机灵、行动力强；本轮通过先假装向前、再侧向落脚的可见行为表达，不用文字解释性格。
subject_definitions.instance_rule: 全片只允许一个黎黎隆物理实体；角色卡多视图不得被解释为多人。
subject_definitions.action_limit: 角色当前生产状态需Work复核，因此限制为小幅头肩转动、单脚抬起与一次侧向落脚、尾部配重；不跑跳、不大幅旋转。

两只机械龙爪脚与一条长机械龙尾
SCENE-07机械空港身份、既有元素、空间连续性和五色色卡逻辑

既有彩色照明区域的一次强度变化

action_plan: 0–4秒：单个黎黎隆保持准备姿态，呼吸与红发末端轻微。
4–7秒：Picture 2中既有彩色照明区域只改变一次强度，不新增光源或物件。
7–11秒：眼睛先跟随，头和肩随后小幅朝前方承诺方向转动。
11–15秒：一只机械爪足抬起但不落地，单条长尾收紧配重，出现轻微会意笑容并停住。
segments.ambient_soundscape: 机械空港持续低频通风、远处结构轻响与轻微装甲关节声；照明强度变化时加入一次短促电流嗡声。仅作音效设计。
segments.emotional_sound_cue: 无歌词、无强拍的克制悬音；抬脚悬停时加入一次很轻的上扬泛音，随后保持未解决状态。
segments.audio_role: support the false-start event and readable hesitation; no beat-synced cutting or MV logic
segments.prompt: 2D hand-drawn cinematic character sequence, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: preserve the exact drawing language, materials, original colors and design details of Picture 1 for the only character, and preserve the verified five-color palette logic and technical-environment identity of Picture 2. Do not impose colors or glowing materials that conflict with either source. VISUAL EXPRESSION: keep the character silhouette exceptionally clear against the information-rich environment; use restrained variable-weight linework, light wash-like shading, soft diffuse illumination and controlled negative space only where compatible with the references. CHARACTER — Picture 1: one and only one LLL-MAIN-001, preserving the established face and competitive expression range, long red hair, red-white-black mechanical armor, cyan functional accents, mechanical claw feet, existing body-module proportions, and exactly one long segmented mechanical dragon tail. Every reference view represents the same single character. ENVIRONMENT — Picture 2: remain in the same five-color mechanical-airfield environment, retaining only its existing elements, spatial continuity and palette relationships. Picture 2 defines the place, not a mandatory framing. Do not invent a door, machine, vehicle, weapon, prop or unseen reverse view. CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: fixed low three-quarter medium-full shot; keep the entire body, both claw feet and the single tail readable; place the character slightly off center and preserve a simple open area in front of the lifted foot, while keeping the verified scene layers behind her. ACTION: she begins in a ready stance, eager to move. An existing colored illumination region in the environment changes intensity once. Her eyes follow it, then her head and shoulders commit slightly toward it. She lifts one claw foot as if she will step forward, but holds it just above the ground. Her tail tightens behind her as counterweight and a small knowing smile appears. She stops in this deliberate false-start pose. Keep one continuous restrained action and exactly one physical character instance. NEGATIVE: no second person, no creature performer, no duplicate or clone, no complete humanoid reflection or shadow double, no split screen, no character-sheet or four-panel output, no extra head, limb, claw foot or tail, no identity or armor redesign, no cyan-white energy humanoid, no unsupported environment object or unseen reverse view, no location replacement, no glossy 3D, no hard digital edges, no rhythmic MV cutting, no text, subtitle, logo or watermark.

segments.continuity_source: Work从A段run_A/run_B中选定一个真实尾帧；B段两抽绑定同一尾帧和同一完整prompt。
segments.start_to_change_to_result: 承接抬脚假动作 → 尾尖先暴露侧向 → 同一爪足侧向落下一次 → 配平、回看并停稳

action_plan: 0–4秒：保持A段选定尾帧，抬起的爪足仍悬空，身体看似准备向前。
4–7秒：单条长尾的尾尖先向侧面轻弹，揭示真实方向。
7–11秒：抬起的同一只爪足只向侧面落下一次，不向前、不连续迈步。
11–15秒：躯干轻跟随，尾部展开配平；她回看未走的方向一次，露出克制得意的半笑并完全停住。
segments.ambient_soundscape: 延续A段机械空港底噪；尾尖动作加入细小关节声，侧向落脚加入一次干燥爪足触地声，装甲随后轻响一次。
segments.emotional_sound_cue: 悬音在尾尖转向时轻微偏转，落脚时以一个温和短促低音解决；无歌词、无强拍，不驱动剪辑。
segments.audio_role: support the reveal of the true direction and final confidence; no beat-synced cutting or MV logic
segments.prompt: 2D hand-drawn cinematic character sequence, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, continuing directly from the Work-selected final frame of Segment A. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: preserve the exact drawing language, materials, original colors and design details of Picture 1 for the only character, and preserve the verified five-color palette logic and technical-environment identity of Picture 2. Do not impose colors or glowing materials that conflict with either source. VISUAL EXPRESSION: maintain clear readable shapes and the same spatial axis; allow only a very slow short push that improves the final expression without losing the mechanical claw feet or the single tail. CHARACTER — Picture 1: the same one and only LLL-MAIN-001 from Segment A, preserving the established face, long red hair, red-white-black mechanical armor, cyan functional accents, mechanical claw feet, body-module proportions and exactly one long segmented mechanical dragon tail. Every reference view represents this same single identity. ENVIRONMENT — Picture 2: remain in the same five-color mechanical-airfield environment with the same existing elements, ground relationship, spatial direction and palette logic established in Segment A. Do not invent architecture, machinery, props or a reverse view. CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: keep the same low three-quarter axis in a medium-full shot; make only a very slow short push after the foot changes direction, and lock the camera if the environment cannot remain coherent. ACTION: begin in the exact false-start pose selected from Segment A, with one claw foot hovering and the body apparently committed forward. Before the environmental illumination changes again, the tip of her single tail flicks toward the opposite side. Her lifted claw foot lands once in that same sideways direction, making one small lateral placement rather than a forward step. Her torso follows only enough to settle over the foot; her tail opens back out to balance. She looks toward the route she did not take, holds a restrained triumphant half-smile, and becomes completely still. Keep the motion continuous, compact and behavior-driven, with exactly one physical character instance. NEGATIVE: no second person, no creature performer, no duplicate or clone, no complete humanoid reflection or shadow double, no split screen, no character-sheet or four-panel output, no extra head, limb, claw foot or tail, no identity or armor redesign, no cyan-white energy humanoid, no unsupported environment object or unseen reverse view, no location replacement, no glossy 3D, no hard digital edges, no rhythmic MV cutting, no text, subtitle, logo or watermark.
